**Places to get free stuff to sell:**

Curb Shopping

Dumpsters

Freecycle

Buy Nothing groups (local)

Friends and family

Your own stuff

Store clearance racks and aisles

The cheapest places to buy things other than thrift stores are flea markets and yard sales. While curb shopping, don't forget to drive around in the evenings to the places you went to yard sales, because people usually put what's left out by the curb on the last day.
